description.default: A draggable, interactive desktop pet that reacts to AI run status. Long press for the menu; size and display timing are configurable.
description.zh-CN: 可拖拽、可点击互动的桌面宠物：跟随 AI 运行状态变化，长按打开菜单，可在配置页调整大小与显示时机。

description.default: Expose ports from the remote SSH server on the phone's loopback, so the AI and the on-device browser can open dev servers behind NAT.
description.zh-CN: 把远程 SSH 服务器上的端口映射到手机本地，让 AI 与手机上的浏览器能打开 NAT 后面的开发服务器。

description.default: A floating desktop pet adapted from dsh-pet for AiCode. It plays transparent animations, reacts to AiCode runs, speaks lines generated from a persona, and can be controlled by AI tools.
description.zh-CN: 将 dsh-pet 适配到 AiCode 的悬浮桌宠：播放透明动画、响应 AiCode 运行状态、按人设生成台词，并支持 AI 工具控制与摸头喂食互动。

description.default: Search Kugou songs and sign in with a phone number or QR code inside AiCode. Playback is left to the system.
description.zh-CN: 在 AiCode 里搜索酷狗歌曲，支持手机验证码与扫码登录。接口沿用开源项目 kgka_Music_hl 的公开服务。
